verdict.rationale: Groq's billing FAQ says paid accounts can "set automated spending limits and receive budget alerts." That covers both halves of the story: a cap and alerts. The feature is listed as a benefit unlocked only after upgrading to a paid plan, and the docs give it a single bullet with no detail. Missing for 10: documentation of whether the limit hard-stops requests once reached, how alert thresholds and notifications are configured, any per-key or per-project caps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
